# defectdojo_notification_webhook (Resource)

Manages a DefectDojo system notification webhook, to which DefectDojo posts the notifications whose settings (`defectdojo_notifications`) choose the `webhooks` channel. Managing webhooks needs a superuser, and DefectDojo sends to them only when the system setting `enable_webhooks_notifications` is on.

DefectDojo deactivates a webhook whose deliveries fail (see `status`). A webhook it deactivates permanently can't be reactivated through the API: edit it in DefectDojo's UI, or create it again with `terraform apply -replace`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "webhook_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "defectdojo_notification_webhook" "chat" {
  name        = "Chat relay"
  url         = "https://hooks.example.com/defectdojo"
  header_name = "Authorization"

  # Never stored in the state. Increase the version to send a new value.
  header_value_wo         = "Bearer ${var.webhook_token}"
  header_value_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the webhook, at most 100 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace, which DefectDojo removes. Names are unique, compared case-sensitively.
- `url` (String) The HTTP or HTTPS URL to which DefectDojo posts notifications, at most 200 characters. DefectDojo doesn't test it.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `header_name` (String) The name of a header that DefectDojo sends with each notification, such as `Authorization`, at most 100 characters. Its value is `header_value_wo`.
- `header_value_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The value of the header named by `header_name`, such as a token, at most 100 characters, which is never stored in the plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later, `header_name` and `header_value_wo_version`. Terraform can't detect a change of a write-only value: change `header_value_wo_version` to send it. DefectDojo returns the value in plain text to every superuser.
- `header_value_wo_version` (Number) The version of `header_value_wo`. The provider sends the header value when the webhook is created, and when the version changes, including when it is set for the first time, for example after an import. Removing it, with `header_value_wo`, clears the header value.

### Read-Only

- `first_error` (String) When deliveries started failing, in RFC 3339 format, if they did.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the webhook.
- `last_error` (String) When a delivery last failed, in RFC 3339 format, if one did.
- `note` (String) DefectDojo's description of the last error or status change, if any.
- `status` (String) The status of the webhook, which DefectDojo sets when deliveries fail: `active`; `inactive_tmp`, paused for about a minute after a 5xx or 429 response or a timeout; `active_tmp`, active again after a temporary failure; or `inactive_permanent`, after a 4xx response, a connection error, a day of errors, or a deactivation in the UI.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = defectdojo_notification_webhook.example
  identity = {
    id = 2
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) ID of the notification webhook

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Notification webhooks are imported by their numeric ID
terraform import defectdojo_notification_webhook.example <id>
```
